notes.title: BWM Collector's Edition Patch Notes v 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31871785/31e0b8ad88c3deabd272a4c978663c4f9768c8e0.png[/img]

[b]Replaceable Dev#58[/b]: Hey there, boys and girls… And bears.

Recently there have been a lot of reports from you guys about the collectors edition default input device. We were busy with some other stuff lately but we finally got around to it. Thank you guys for the patience and support…

[b]Amber[/b]: Ugh, this is boring stuff… Soooo boring, omg, I’m dying…

[b]Replaceable Dev#58[/b]: Umm, but it’s the patch notes, I have to keep it short and to the point and…

[b]Amber[/b]: You’re just the worst… Let me!

[b]Replaceable Dev#58[/b]: (sighs)

[b]Amber[/b]: Heeeeeey, um… You guys! 
These dorks over here fixed some boring stuff I don’t really care about… If you really want to know you can check it out below. But I on the other hand made that horsie up there, look at it! 

So cute, right? 😊


[h1]Fixes[/h1] 
[list]
    [*][b]Game Progress Migration[/b]
Episode 2 CE is now unlocked if standalone episode 1 has been finished, also episode 3 CE is unlocked if standalone episode 2 has been finished

    [*][b]Defaulting to Gamepad[/b]
Game no longer defaults to gamepad, it defaults to keyboard and mouse. Added "Default to gamepad" setting to enable switching and defaulting to gamepad

    [*][b]Achivements[/b] 
Achievements from standalone episodes are now translated to collectors edition upon next BWM CE game start

    [*][b]Few Localisation Updates[/b] 
[/list] 

[h1]Not Yet Fixed[/h1] 
[list]
    [*][b]Save Transfer[/b]
We are working on it. It should be up soon.
[/list] 


TL;DR Fixed things, I guess… Also boring. But also horsie <3

#blessed #horsies #amberisgenius #sotalented #likeomg

notes.title: The Collector's Edition is out!
notes.content:

Finally it's here. The Bear With Me - Collector's Edition is live and kicking. As announced, it contains:
[list]
    [*]all three episodes of Bear With Me - with controller support :D
    [*]the full soundtrack
    [*]a 90 page digital art book
    [*]and the complete puzzle & script design docs

notes.title: BWM Episode 3 Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
- Solved the issue with the Save file created during Vault puzzle before update 1.1.0, it was broken with update 1.1.0, and now it should be working

Wish you all a great time and lots of adventures with our detective duo, there are questions to be answered and puzzles to be solved, follow the clues, snoop around, have fun! 😉

notes.title: Episodes and Bundle Sale & Item Transfer Fix
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25596398/65334f69bd5e39539f768a3409998dab927b6f56.png[/img]

Howdy crime solvers,

Another fix hits the game:

[h1]BWM Episode 01 - Update v2.1.2[/h1]

[b]Episode choice data transfer[/b]
[list]
[*]No longer is the latest save or autosave file used for data transfer to Episode 2, now we use a custom choice data file instead,
[*]Each time a player reaches the credits screen, and only then, Episode 1 choice data file is created or overwritten,
[*]Choice data cannot be overwritten manually by the player (it's not a standard save or autosave file)
[/list]

[h1]BWM Episode 02 - Update v2.2.1[/h1]

[b]Episode choice data transfer[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated the choice data transfer system to work with new Episode 1 choice data transfer system,
[*]No longer is the latest Episode 1 save or autosave file used for data transfer to Episode 2, now we use a custom choice data file instead.
[/list]

Each time player reaches the Episode 1 credits screen, and only then, Episode 1 choice data file is created or overwritten, and now Episode 2 reads data from this file.

[h1]Episodes and Bundle Sale[/h1]

For all of you who have been waiting to snatch the episodes at a different time, later today there might be a good opportunity to do so.

[b]Both episodes will be generously discounted and if you snatch both you'll also get the Bundle multiplier - best way to start the weekend.[/b]

Over & out.

notes.title: BWM Episode 02 - Update v2.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Save/Autosave[/b]

- fixed issue where the data from Episode 1 was not transferred into Episode 2.
• item transfer from Episode 1 Inventory to Episode 2 Inventory 
• we collect Episode 1 data from your last Episode 1 save or autosave file
• the last save or autosave file is the one with the latest date/time
• you need to create a new save or autosave slot in Episode 1, after that you need to run Episode 2 and doing so you'll get data transferred from Episode 1 to Episode 2 
• this is a temporary data transfer system, we are working on a better solution for this issue that will not rely on the last save or autosave file

notes.title: Updates / Fixes #2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25596398/7d3723612d7ba4ae65cf3fb615f2033bc82fad65.png[/img]

Hello there bear lovers,

We've been busy solving a couple of the major issues that have been bugging you.

[h1]UPDATES[/h1]

[b]1) Removed Game Launcher[/b]

We no longer use the Unity Launcher when launching the game. Now when you launch the game through Steam you will directly go to the game. This also includes the following update point.

[b]2) Added in-game Resolution Change Support[/b]

We have had troubles with all non 16:9 aspect ratio screens you have been playing on. This is now fixed and you are able to play the game on any aspect ratio, either full screen or windowed.

The resolution controls can be found inside the main menu scene under the Settings button. You will both be able to chose your target resolution and window / full screen mode.

[h1]FIXES[/h1]

[b]1) Localization Fix[/b]

We changed some of the localisation files and in-game texts. They now have a more natural translation. Thank you for letting us know.

[b]2) Minor Bug Fixes[/b]

We do see every comment that you leave on the Discussions so feel free to continue to do so. We will do our best to resolve any issues you find. This process helps us a lot to foresee any bugs in future episode too and resolve them before you guys need to encounter them.

That's all for now. We are busy with the second episode, no spoilers yet but a couple of teasers soon? Maybe :)

notes.title: Thank you for bearing with us!
notes.content:
Hello fellow detectives,

Time for a tad of updating. Thank you for all the positive feedback, we are very happy that you are enjoying the game. Also kudos to all the bug reports we have received. Although we tested the bear out of it, you were able to find some fluffy stuff that we never encountered which helped us greatly to solve it ASAP.

If you are wondering why your game was updating on Steam, here’s why, we:
[list]
[*]fixed a bug where you could exit Amber's Room without Ted E. Bear
[*]fixed the achievements, all are now obtainable as intended (Missed Opportunity)
[*]fixed Ted's hints, they were not working as intended in some situations
[*]fixed the subtitle encoding, some special characters were not being displayed correctly
[*]fixed some minor spelling errors
[*]fixed an error in which the Clock in the Hallway did not have the proper animation enabled
[*]fixed some other minor pesky bugs
[/list]

Some of the first impressions are arriving on various gaming web sites, if you enjoyed the game you can help us spread the word and share them with your fellow friend snoops.
[list]
[*][i]"The story and characters are extremely well written, and the inter-character dialogue is a joy to behold”[/i] - [b]93/100[/b] [url=http://pixelpopnetwork.com.au/Review/bear-episode-1/]Pixel Pop Network[/url]
[*][i]"Bear With Me is a wonderful point-and-click adventure game which crosses the cute with the serious. This chapter starts a wonderful story that I hope to continue exploring in the future.”[/i] - [b]8/10[/b] [url=https://www.okgames.com.au/reviews/bear-with-me/]OK Games[/url]
[*][i]“Bear With Me oozes style and humour, and we’re looking forward to seeing how it will unfold and which other characters we’ll meet along the way.”[/i] - [b]4/5[/b] [url=http://www.clickonline.com/games/bear-with-me-review/37177/]Click Online[/url][/list]

We are keeping an eye on all the discussions, comments and reviews so don’t worry, we are listening. There will be more giveaways for Bear With Me sooner rather than later so if you would like to win a copy for your loved ones keep an eye on our social media channels.

Talk to you soon.
